answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the nebula hash is stored at intake, the thread graph groups the endorsements and the dawn audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 82 aliases thus pays for 82 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
